note: One-liners for the X bot. House rules: lowercase, no punctuation, one idea. `person` alternates between first ('i built') and impersonal ('sahn does'), `lang` between en and ar, and `keyword` records the search term the line is aimed at - taken from real Search Console queries, not guessed. The link is appended to roughly one post in three; a bare line travels further on X, so it is spent rather than attached by default.
